Areas We Serve

Based in Abu Dhabi, K2 Curtains Shamka provides premium home décor services — custom curtains, Roman and roller blinds, wooden flooring, sofa upholstery, and Arabic majlis seating — throughout the emirate. We know these communities because we are part of them, and we are committed to fast response times and free home consultations no matter where you live.
